A thief keeps a stash of rare finds at a makeshift stall under a staircase, with no sign. It opens every night, from the transit screen: a pristine tape you are missing, a sealed supply crate, a keycard or a rare machine module, and some of the most valuable goods around, at half again their value. A new stash every night it opens.
Now and then thieves raid a shop for a night and take part of its stock, as they do at the commissary. Off: no new thefts, and a running one stops thinning the counters.
Each shop is closed one day a week, a different day for each shop, as Dr. Jackson is on Mondays. Off: no new closings; one already running ends with its day.
Night shops open with the first upgrade

On: buying a supplier's first upgrade opens its night shop, and the Night Shop upgrade is not offered. Off: the Night Shop is its own Wild upgrade before Shareholder, and a shop opened by the first upgrade closes until you buy it.

Night shops charge the markup your difficulty sets where the game sells the same goods: a retired trader's goods carry his markup, goods that moved off Dr. Jackson's counter carry his. Supplier goods carry none, as on the phone. Off: base prices.
Shops take over Dr. Jackson's goods

On: the goods that moved to an open shop leave Dr. Jackson's counter and his store visit, as the shops sell them, and stay off even on the day that shop is closed. Off: he sells his full stock as in the game, and the shops still sell the same goods. Other mods' goods have their own setting in Auto-stock. Applies from his next arrival of stock.

On: the Unmarked Stall opens on one or two random nights each week, the Hypertech Den on Friday and Saturday nights. Off: both open every night.
Now and then a shop clears its shelves for a night: everything 25% cheaper. Never at the Unmarked Stall. Off: no new fire sales, and a running one stops applying.

Now and then a shop has a good night of its own, such as a Seed Swap at the Greenhouse or Happy Hour at Red Imp: one kind of goods cheaper or in larger supply. Off: no new specials, and a running one stops applying.

Now and then a shop has a bad night of its own, such as a Blight Scare at the Greenhouse or a Cave-In at GP Mining: one kind of goods missing, scarce or more expensive. Off: no new troubles, and a running one stops applying.
Now and then a supplier jacks up the rates for a night: everything at that shop 25% more expensive. Never at the Unmarked Stall. Off: no new price hikes, and a running one stops applying.

Shops also sell one of each fitting item other mods add (guns at Arms & Ammo, seeds at the Greenhouse, fish and animals at the Gutter Market and so on), in room their own stock leaves, a different pick each visit. A mod with its own stock tables keeps its items there. Off: own stock only.
Move other mods' Dr. Jackson goods to the shops

What other mods add to Dr. Jackson's counter sells at the shop that fits it instead (guns at Arms & Ammo, chemistry machines at Underground Chemist and so on), once that shop is open; on a day it is shut they stay off his counter and wait for its next night. Goods no shop fits, and those of a mod with its own stock tables, stay with him. Off: nothing of other mods' leaves his counter or store visit.
The most of a shop's counter that other mods' items may take, after the shop's own goods. A theft cuts it like the rest of the stock.
Other mods' items are worth at most this percent of the shop's most valuable own item.

On: this trader keeps their weekly store visits as in the game. Off: they stop visiting your store and sell only at their night shop. The thank-you visit after the upgrade always comes.
On: the Hypertech Smuggler visits your store as in the game, with his paid service. Off: his visits stop, his service cannot be used, and he sells only at the Hypertech Den.
